text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I have no excuses. It is entirely due 
to my own lack of ability.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have shown you a side of myself 
unbecoming of a Mejiro Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry that I could not meet 
your expectations...
choice_data_list: Let's turn that frustration into fuel!
Then do you want to run away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It wouldn't mean anything unless it 
leads to the next step.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, what a bitter taste frustration has. 
...I have no desire to ever sample it 
again.
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's taste the sweetness of 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sweet... A sweet victory. Yes, that is 
precisely... what befits a Mejiro 
Umamusume like myself to savor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer-san, once again... please make 
me stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Running away is out of the question. I 
will not drag the Mejiro family name 
through the mud any further!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course. I will definitely win 
next time. Without fail!
